Folded fan cowls and split ribbon cloth silhouettes. Soot-black, dull vermilion, oxidized gold, warm ivory and restrained elemental accents. Cracked glazed staffs, scorched brass and chipped obsidian wardstones. Severe ember-lit ceremony, broad matte dark ground interrupted by small islands of worn glaze; neither glossy 3D nor clean ornamental design.
The above direction is painted at EXTREME LONG SHOT scale: tiny people, vast ground. Never zoom in to show costume detail.
